title: Le Serveur des Anciens
description: Basically add "quality of life", beauty or optimizing mods.
body:
Overall, this modpack is light, and just aims to add a few mods that simplify life a little, add beauty or optimize the game without fundamentally changing it.

**Features**:
- Quality of life: forget about creating long, noisy **chunk loaders**, or searching the internet for **item recipes**, or not knowing where to put your torches... and finally have the option of **putting on elytras with your chestplate**!
- Optimization: Make your **game more fluid** with well-known mods such as “Indium”, “sodium”, “entity culling” and others.
- Beauty: Add a little beauty to your game with **pre-installed shaders**.
